guided.name: Guided
guided.short: We move forward together, one step at a time
guided.long: IDEM tells you what to do, in what order, and does it with you. Ideal when you don't know where to start.

chat.name: Chat
chat.long: A conversation, like talking to an adviser. Describe what you need and IDEM generates it.

advanced.name: Dashboard
advanced.long: The full workspace: every module is directly accessible, in whatever order you like.

switcher.label: Mode
switcher.panelTitle: Choose how you want to work
switcher.footer: You can switch modes at any time. Your project and documents stay exactly the same.
